title: Algebra 2: Complex Numbers & Quadratics
tagline: Complete the square, meet i, master complex arithmetic, and finish the discriminant story every quadratic deserves.

chapters.title: Completing the Square
chapters.description: Build perfect squares, solve by completing the square, and derive vertex form yourself.

chapters.title: The Imaginary Unit
chapters.description: Meet i, ride the four-step cycle of its powers, and plot complex numbers on the plane.

chapters.title: Complex Arithmetic
chapters.description: Add, subtract, and multiply complex numbers, then use conjugates to divide.

chapters.title: Complex Roots of Quadratics
chapters.description: Solve x² = −k, run the quadratic formula past a negative discriminant, and complete the two-roots-always story.

chapters.title: Roots & Methods
chapters.description: Extend sum and product to conjugate pairs, rebuild quadratics from their roots, and choose the fastest solving method every time.
